description: Chat bubbles that grow from their sender’s corner, with grouped messages, reply actions and delayed reactions, built on UI SDK core.
moves: A new bubble grows from 60% at its sender’s corner while its blur clears.
Grouped bubbles arrive in order, with reactions following their bubble.
A bubble rendered as a button or link presses in and springs back.
keyboard: Moves to interactive bubbles and reaction controls.
Follows a focused bubble link or activates a bubble button.
Activates a bubble rendered as a button.
